exposure: Positive psychological nursing combined with free posture during labor
outcome: Stress degree during delivery (Hamilton anxiety scale (HAMA))
Stress degree during delivery (Hamilton depression scale (HAMD))
Time of first stage of labor
Time of second stage of labor
Time of third stage of labor
Pain level during the active period of the first stage of labor
cohort: The study participants were 106 primipara women with singleton spontaneous delivery admitted to the obstetrics department.
finding: Positive psychological nursing combined with free posture significantly reduced anxiety and depression during childbirth, shortened the first and second stages of labor, and lowered pain levels during the active stage of labor.
